description: This file defines a React functional component named 'NotesLayout' that provides the structural layout for a note-taking application's frontend. It sets up a three-section layout with a header, sidebar, and main content area, supporting injection of child components and a left panel.

methods.name: NotesLayout({ children, leftPanel })
methods.description: React functional component that renders the main layout with a header, sidebar, and content area, accepting 'children' and 'leftPanel' as props.
